The vault's lesson note says that after you change any limit, you should re-run everything downstream that derives a value from it, not just the code that references it by name. Raising the lexical candidate limit to 200 made the expansion budget `min(2*len(notes), 20) - len(notes)` negative. Graph expansion then reported `ok` while adding zero nodes, and no test failed. The note also says to treat an impossible metric as a bug in the measurement before believing it. Here the impossible metric was context recall above candidate recall.
